title: Phase 06 — Direction & Discovery (15–17 years)
primaryObjective: Advanced learning and career discovery — the young person goes deep, tests paths, and learns to steer their own growth.
summary: In the later teens, the young person can learn at an advanced level and begins to shape a direction for their life. The focus is depth in chosen areas, discovering possible careers and paths through real experience, and building self-direction, financial literacy, and ethical judgement. Rather than locking into a single track, the aim is to explore widely through doing — internships, projects, mentors — and to learn how to keep learning. The platform supports learners, mentors, and educators while keeping wellbeing and safety central.
guidingPrinciple: Discovery over prescription. Help the young person test many paths through real experience and learn to direct their own growth, rather than being pushed down a track chosen for them.

developmentDomains.focus: Advanced analysis, research, synthesis across subjects, and tackling open-ended, real-world problems.
Career discovery, workplace skills, earning and budgeting, and understanding real paths and their trade-offs.
Applying and building with technology in a chosen field, and using digital tools professionally and ethically.
Ethical decision-making, rights and responsibilities, and active, informed citizenship.
Managing pressure and uncertainty, self-motivation, handling failure, and protecting mental health.
Collaboration, leadership, respectful and healthy relationships, and professional conduct.
Turning ideas into action, initiative, and leading small teams or ventures.
Service, volunteering, and using emerging skills to help others.

yearPlans.label: Age 15–16
objectives: Go deep in one or two areas of genuine interest through real projects.
Explore careers and paths by meeting people and trying work, not just reading.
Build self-direction: set goals, plan, and manage time without being told.
Strengthen financial literacy with real earning, saving, and budgeting.
capabilities: Produces advanced work in a chosen area and can explain their methods.
Describes several realistic paths and what each involves day to day.
Sets and pursues goals independently and manages their own schedule.
Manages income and a budget and understands saving and simple interest.

yearPlans.label: Age 16–17
objectives: Undertake an internship, apprenticeship, or substantial real-world project.
Make reasoned decisions about next steps while keeping options open.
Lead or co-lead a team, venture, or service initiative.
Develop resilience and healthy coping for pressure and setbacks.
capabilities: Contributes real value in a work or project setting and reflects on it.
Weighs education and career options against their interests and values.
Leads a small team or project and handles setbacks constructively.
Recognises stress and uses healthy strategies and support when needed.

daily.title: Deliberate practice
daily.description: Spend focused time improving one real skill, tracking progress and seeking feedback rather than just logging hours.

daily.title: Learn how to learn
daily.description: Reflect briefly on what you learned today and how you learned it, strengthening self-directed learning.

weekly.title: Talk to someone who does the work
weekly.description: Interview or shadow a person in a field you're curious about and note what the work is really like.

weekly.title: Ship something real
weekly.description: Advance a project toward a real audience or user — publish, pitch, or deliver — and gather honest feedback.

weekly.title: Money and plan review
weekly.description: Review budget, savings, and progress toward goals, and adjust your plan for the coming week.

parentGuidance.topic: Be a guide, not a director
parentGuidance.guidance: Support exploration of many paths rather than pushing one. The goal is a young person who can choose for themselves and change course with confidence.
Internships, projects, and ventures that don't work out are valuable learning, not wasted time. Celebrate the attempt and the lessons.
Exams and future decisions can feel overwhelming. Keep talking, keep perspective, and involve professionals if you see sustained distress. The platform never replaces that support.

milestones.description: Sets goals and manages their own learning and time independently
Explores careers through real experience and names realistic options
Manages income and a budget and understands saving
Uses healthy coping strategies under academic and social pressure

safety.guidance: High pressure around exams and the future is common. Persistent anxiety, depression, or burnout should be addressed with a professional. In crisis, contact local emergency or crisis services immediately.
Know your rights in work and internships: fair treatment, safe conditions, and never being pressured into anything unsafe or unethical. Speak to a trusted adult if something feels wrong.
Be alert to scams, get-rich-quick schemes, and online financial pressure. Verify before committing money, and ask a trusted adult or professional for advice on anything significant.
Respect, consent, and boundaries remain essential. Abusive or coercive situations should be shared with a trusted adult or professional; the platform points you to people, not away from them.

outcomes: The learner produces advanced work in chosen areas and can explain their methods.
The learner has explored real careers and can describe realistic options and trade-offs.
The learner directs their own learning, time, and goals.
The learner manages money responsibly and understands saving and budgeting.
The learner handles pressure and setbacks with healthy strategies and support.

projects.title: Real-world internship or apprenticeship
projects.description: Spend time in a genuine work setting, contribute to real tasks, and reflect on what the field involves and whether it fits.

projects.title: Launch a micro-venture or initiative
projects.description: Start a small business, club, or service initiative: plan it, run it, handle real money or impact, and learn from the outcome.

projects.title: Deep-dive portfolio project
projects.description: Create a substantial piece of work in a chosen field to a professional standard and present it to a real audience for feedback.

appFeatures.userJourney: A learner explores real paths through interviews, day-in-the-life content, and project matches, keeping options open rather than narrowing too soon.
A learner sets goals, plans deliberate practice, and reflects on progress, building the habit of steering their own growth.
A learner connects with a vetted mentor for guidance while the app keeps parents/guardians informed and never replaces professional or family support.
An educator coordinates internships and project-based learning, tracking real-world competencies and reflection rather than exam scores alone.
